heading: Volunteer with Team Taryn
intro: Every upcoming volunteer shift in one place. Pick one that fits your schedule and sign up. No experience needed — we’ll train you.
no_shifts_text: Join the volunteer list below and we’ll reach out as soon as the next one is scheduled.
form_text: Tell us which shift you want (or just that you’d like to help) and someone from Team Taryn will be in touch with the details.
